name: Chatham Islands Pigeon
rangeDescription: Chatham islands
description: Only large pigeon on the Chatham Islands. Shows a distinctive white belly and maroon-tinged upper wings.

name: Black-bellied Seedcracker
rangeDescription: Ivory coast to gabon, northern angola, eastern democratic republic of the congo, tanzania, and northeastern zambia
description: Colorful, chunky waxbill with a massive, conical bill. Both sexes have a red hood and tail, but males have a black base color and more red, and females a brown base color.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rosy Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Humid forest of western and central africa
description: A nomadic and locally migratory bee-eater of rainforests, savannas, rivers, and glades, where it can be seen flying high overhead or perched high in trees. Distinctive, with long triangular wings, rosy pink underparts, a black eye-line, a clean white moustache, and evenly gray upperparts.

name: Green-backed Hillstar
rangeDescription: East slope of andes from southern colombia (nariño) to eastern ecuador (south at least to morona-santiago) and northern peru (amazonas, san martín)
description: Large hummingbird with limited range on east slope of Andes from southern Colombia to Ecuador. Overall bronzy-greenish with blue throat.

name: Siberian Pipit
rangeDescription: Northern to eastern russia in southeastern taymyr peninsula, western siberian plateau, and from eastward of lena river, yakutsk region, and lake baikal eastward to chukotskiy peninsula, commander islands, sakhalin, and kuril islands; winters from japan and korea to southern and southeastern continental asia; recorded westward to israel and turkey
description: Slender and drab songbird of open country. Brownish above with heavy streaking below.

name: Yellow-rumped Serin
rangeDescription: Savanna of eritrea and northern ethiopia
description: A very plain gray-brown seedeater with a white throat and a yellow rump that is conspicuous in flight. Found locally in savanna, woodland, and cultivated areas, usually in small flocks.

name: Fairy Pitta
rangeDescription: Southern japan to korea and southeastern china; winters to southeastern asia and borneo
description: A beautiful ground-dweller of well-shaded forests. Adult mostly green above, creamy tan below, with vivid red patch in undertail and central belly and multicolored head, with black mask, tan eyebrow, white throat, and rufous-and-black crown.

name: Band-bellied Crake
rangeDescription: Northeastern asia; winters in southeastern asia and greater sundas
description: Skulky and difficult to see, this medium-sized crake is often detected through its unique song, a hollow hoot-knocking that can be likened to a wood rattle or rapidfire tapping on a tiny high-pitched drum. Favors extremely well-vegetated marsh margins, often in areas with bushes and short trees, and sometimes near cultivation.

name: Black-tailed Nativehen
rangeDescription: Aquatic habitats of australia (except northern and eastern coastal areas)
description: Small waterhen with an erect black tail (no white edges) resembling that of a domestic chicken. Note pale green base to the bill with a yellow tip and a red spot, bright red-pink legs, and pale spots on flanks.

name: Citron-crested Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Sumba (lesser sundas)
description: A medium-sized white cockatoo with an orange crest; endemic to the island of Sumba, where it is highly threatened by trapping and habitat loss. Raucous and social, usually seen in large flocks flying noisily over forested areas.

name: Halmahera Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: Halmahera (northern moluccas)
description: A medium-sized cuckooshrike from Halmahera with an entirely dark slate-gray body and a black face and throat. Singles and pairs occur within forest, principally in the foothills, but also in the lowlands.

name: Malayan Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: High mountains of peninsular thailand and malay peninsula
description: Predominantly cinnamon-brown, this attractive laughingthrush also has olive-yellow wings, silvery cheeks and nape, and a thin but bright white eye-ring. Moves actively in pairs or small flocks on or near the ground in the dense undergrowth of montane forests.

name: White-cheeked Tern
rangeDescription: Islands and coasts of red sea and persian gulf to india
description: Sub-tropical tern; slightly smaller than Common Tern with a lighter and less powerful flight, as well as a longer-billed and shorter-legged profile. In all plumages, note the darker upperparts, including the rump and uppertail.

name: Tristram's Storm-Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds and ranges hawaii, izu, and volcano islands
description: Dark brown, fork-tailed seabird of the northwestern and central Pacific, where it breeds on Japanese and Hawaiian islands. Generally forages far offshore and does not associate with boats.

name: Silvery-throated Spinetail
rangeDescription: Eastern andes of northern colombia (boyacá and cundinamarca)
description: A typical-looking spinetail with a very restricted range in central Colombia. Gray-brown overall with a rusty or rufous crown and wings, and a long, spiky grayish tail.

name: Long-billed Crow
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (morotai, halmahera, kayoa, bacan, obi, and kasiruta)
description: A distinctive crow with a strikingly long bill, noticeable even in flight. Adults have purple-glossed blackish plumage and a prominent pale eye.

name: Masked Bunting
rangeDescription: Sakhalin and southern kuril islands to honshu; winters to ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: A small migratory songbird breeding in low to mid-elevation, moist mixed forest and wintering in woodland and scrub, preferring thick undergrowth, especially dwarf bamboo. Brown, streaked upperparts, grayish head and pale yellow underparts with fine, dark streaking.

name: White-lored Warbler
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Gray and yellow warbler found only in the Santa Marta Mountains of Colombia. Note the white crescents above and below the eye, white stripe between the eye and the bill, and the dark crown stripes.

name: Munchique Wood-Wren
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia
description: A small, stub-tailed wren endemic to Colombia’s western Andes. It has a long, white eyebrow and a streaky face.

name: Guadalcanal Owl
rangeDescription: Guadalcanal (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A rather small owl with lightly spotted brown upperparts and creamy underparts thickly barred with reddish brown. Inhabits forests from lowlands up into the highlands.
